testcase.name: All 89 declared operations share fail-closed ingress; unknown route/method/path/query is rejected
JSON media/UTF8/syntax/1MiB limit and compressed ingress reject before any handler
Origin is exact configured value, independent of spoofed Host/forwarded headers; no CORS
Session/CSRF hooks fail closed; forced-password exceptions and hidden project404 preserve boundaries
Body allowlist/trim/null/coercion and idempotency UUID validation leave secrets untouched
Pagination/query wire is strict with page1/size50 defaults and max100; export cannot paginate
Public response schema rejects sensitive fields; safe error/logger/requestId/currentVersion/retry headers match wire
No-body command rejects injected JSON and 204 emits no response body
Merged task validation is deferred to authoritative transaction state, not request omissions
Health routes preserve wire/query allowlist; HSTS respects configured trusted proxy
